The '''2020 LPL Spring''' split was the first split of the year in China’s franchised '''LoL Pro League''' (''LPL''), organized by Tencent Games. Sixteen teams competed from 13 January to 2 May, with matches originally scheduled across team homeground venues in Shanghai, Hangzhou, Chengdu, and Suzhou. The league opened offline but was suspended after Week 1 due to the COVID-19 outbreak, returning on 9 March in a fully online format for the remainder of the Regular Season and Playoffs. The split followed a single round-robin Regular Season and a Single Elimination Playoffs bracket, with the champion earning championship points toward qualification for international events. Matches were played on patches ranging from 10.1 to 10.8.

==Format==
*'''Group Stage''' - ''January 13th - April 20th''
** Single round robin, {{Abbr/Bo3}}
*** {{bgcolortext|byeup|''1st and 2nd place''}} advance to the Semfinals of the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|seedup|''3rd and 4th place''}} advance to the Quarterfinals of the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|up|''5th till 8th place''}} advance to Round 1 of the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|stay|''9th till 17th place''}} are eliminated from this split.
****1st, 4th, 5th, and 8th seed will be in one bracket. The other 4 seeds will be in the other.
*'''Playoffs''' - ''April 22nd - May 2nd''
** Single elimination
** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo5}}
** Top 4 qualify for <s>[[Rift Rivals/LCK-LPL-PCS-VCS/2020|Rift Rivals 2020 - LCK vs LPL vs PCS vs VCS]]</s>
** Winner qualifies for [[Mid-Season Invitational/2020|Mid Season Invitational 2020]]

*'''From Week 2, the official of LPL has decided to postpone the tournament due to the Coronavirus problem in China'''<ref name="postponed cn">{{cite web|url=https://card.weibo.com/article/m/show/id/2309404464923395621019?_wb_client_=1|title=关于英雄联盟赛事（LPL及LDL）延期说明|date=2020-01-26|author=英雄联盟赛事|publisher=Weibo|language={{Flag|cn}}}}</ref><ref name="LPL postponed">{{cite web |url=https://twitter.com/lplenglish/status/1221301834909769729|title=We have decided to postpone week 2 of the LPL until we can ensure the safety and health of our players and fans. 
|author=LPL|date=2020-01-26|publisher=Twitter|language={{Flag|usuk}} English}}</ref>
** '''The tournament returned by being played in online matches from March 9th'''.<ref name="online">{{cite web|url=https://weibo.com/5756404150/IwgPefsl8|title=2020LPL春季赛3月9日线上恢复开赛|date=2020-02-28|author=英雄联盟赛事|publisher=Weibo|language={{Flag|cn}}}}</ref>
